meta.purpose: Served by /fallback-index when the database is unreachable, so the picker and the statewide figures survive an outage.
meta.district_source: union of the committed static payloads — exactly the districts that have content to show without a database
meta.figures_note: Statewide medians move only when TEA publishes. The page labels them as a snapshot while the database is down.

parts.label: Classroom teaching
parts.contents: Teachers' pay and benefits, classroom materials, school libraries and media specialists, and training for teachers.

parts.label: Construction
parts.contents: New buildings, major renovations, land, and large equipment purchases.

parts.label: Debt payments
parts.contents: Principal and interest on bonds voters approved in past elections — mostly for buildings that are already standing.

parts.label: Principals & administration
parts.contents: Principals and assistant principals, campus front offices, the superintendent's office, and central business functions.

parts.label: Buildings & upkeep
parts.contents: Custodians, electricity and water, groundskeeping, and the repairs that keep buildings open.

parts.label: Buses & meals
parts.contents: School buses, routes and drivers, plus cafeterias and the food served in them.

parts.label: Counselors, nurses & support
parts.contents: Counselors, social workers, and school nurses.

parts.label: Sports & activities
parts.contents: Athletics, band, UIL academics, clubs, and other activities outside class time.

parts.label: Safety & technology
parts.contents: Campus security and policing, plus the district's computers, networks, and data systems. (Technology cannot be separated from security in this dataset.)

parts.label: Community services
parts.contents: Programs the district runs for the wider community, such as adult education and parent outreach.

parts.label: Everything else
parts.contents: Everything the function codes above do not capture — including transfers between funds and smaller categories TEA does not break out separately.
parts.codes: residual: total spending minus the categories above
